column1: # The runners use this fixed domain table:
#   fidonet  /tmp/fido   outb   z {2,-1}   idomain none     alias4 none
#   othernet /tmp/other  outb   z {3,-1}   idomain other.net alias4 none
#   aliasnet /tmp/fido   outb   z {-1,-1}  idomain none     alias4 fidonet
# The runners use this fixed AKA: 2:5047/13@fidonet.
#   The empty domain is the last field.
# addr_format(z, net, node, p, domain, force_point) -> string
# addr_filename(z, net, node, p, domain) -> path
# addr_domain(z, net, node, p, domain, root) -> FQDN
# See tests/README.md for the field format.
